verdict.rationale: Column's checks docs state that customers can both issue and deposit checks through its APIs, which covers the core of the story. A 2022 Column engineer comment that checks were then in beta is a maturity caveat, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of check image capture/upload for deposits, detail on check issuance mechanics (printing/mailing, positive pay), and independent hands-on corroboration of the check flows in production.
